lines.t: I sit here in the night, but I see the light of your love
And I'm waiting for you until you take me away
I know your promise is true, oh, I long to be with you
Oh Lord, I'm waiting for you
Until you come one day
Oh, I'm waiting for you till you take me away
I remain faithful, I'll stay awake
And until I see your face
Hear your voice call my name
I'll be waiting, waiting for you
You bring light to the darkest places
You shine so bright
Even in the shadows
Even in the night
And I look forward to seeing you
And as I wait

And until you call me
Lord, I'll be waiting, waiting for you
Oh, I'm waiting for you till you take me away

The way I remain faithful
